citations.claim: Microsoft's M365 consumer products revenue grew 5% and its cloud services revenue grew 6% in constant currency.
citations.source_text: M365 consumer products and cloud services revenue increased 5% and 6% in constant currency.

citations.claim: LinkedIn revenue rose 10% and 9% in constant currency, slightly ahead of expectations, with growth across all lines of business.
citations.source_text: Linked in revenue increased 10% and 9% in constant currency, slightly ahead of expectations, with growth across all lines of business.
